items.author: Trump
items.text: United States aircraft just struck Iranian missile and drone storage locations, and coastal radar sites, for violating the Cease Fire Agreement, AGAIN! It is very possible that they will never learn! There may come a point when we are no longer able to be reasonable, and will be forced to militarily complete the job that we very successfully started. If that happens, the Islamic Republic of Iran will no longer exist! President DJT
items.summary_cn: Trump宣布美军空袭伊朗导弹/无人机仓库与沿海雷达站，因其违反停火协议，并威胁可能全面动武——重大地缘事件，短线利多原油与国防、利空风险资产。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk's SpaceX Could Acquire T-Mobile In Wireless Push, Says Analyst
items.summary_cn: 分析师称SpaceX可能收购T-Mobile以推进无线业务，若落地将形成航天+电信巨无霸，重大利好SpaceX估值（SpaceX未上市，关联SPCH）。

items.author: Trump
items.text: WTI CRUDE - $69, and heading down. This is less than it was prior to the start of the Denuclearization of Iran! President DJT
items.summary_cn: Trump喊话WTI原油跌至$69并将继续下行，关联伊朗去核化进展；油价走低利好下游与消费，间接利空传统油气但降低整体通胀压力。

items.author: Musk
items.text: SpaceX Short Sellers Retreat Before Elon Musk Touts Grok 4.5 AI Model: Short Seller Tracker
items.summary_cn: SpaceX空头在Musk力推Grok 4.5模型前回补撤出，显示市场对xAI进展与SpaceX估值上修持正面态度，利好SpaceX相关持仓。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk says SpaceX is putting top Starship and Starlink engineers to work on Grok
items.summary_cn: Musk将SpaceX旗下Starship与Starlink顶尖工程师调至Grok团队，显示AI优先级提升、xAI获得SpaceX资源倾斜，间接利好SpaceX相关持仓。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk loses trillionaire status as SpaceX and Tesla stock drops
items.summary_cn: Musk因SpaceX与Tesla股价下跌而短暂失去万亿富豪身家，Tesla承压信号明显。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk-connected company buys land, water infrastructure before Grimes County’s SpaceX tax vote
items.summary_cn: Musk关联公司在SpaceX所在Grimes County的房产税投票前购入土地与水利设施，反映SpaceX持续扩张与基础设施投入。

items.author: Trump
items.text: IRAN HAS REQUESTED A MEETING. IT WILL TAKE PLACE TOMORROW IN DOHA! President DJT
items.summary_cn: Trump宣布伊朗已请求在多哈举行会谈，直接关系中东局势与原油价格走向。

items.author: Trump
items.text: GAS PRICES COMING DOWN, FAST! REPORT ANY ABUSES AT RETAIL LEVEL!!! President DJT
items.summary_cn: Trump宣称汽油价格快速下跌并要求举报零售端价格操纵，宏观层面利好消费者支出与通胀预期。

items.author: Trump
items.text: BIG WIN just moments ago at the Supreme Court, in the Slaughter Case, confirming Presidential Power in our Country to remove Executive Branch Officers and Agency Appointees, or Representatives, under Article II. This Decision was long sought by United States Presidents, dating all the way back to the 1930s. It is such an Honor to be the sitting President who won this Historic and Unprecedented Ruling, one of the most important ever given with respect to Presidential Powers. Thank you for your attention to this matter! President DONALD J. TRUMP
items.summary_cn: Trump称最高法院在Slaughter案中作出重大裁决，确认总统可依宪法第二条移除行政分支官员，利好总统对独立机构的掌控力（如SEC、CFTC等）。

items.author: Trump
items.text: The Cook Lawsuit, having to do with her suitability in sitting on the Board of the Federal Reserve, was sent back by the Supreme Court on a strictly procedural basis, we will take appropriate action immediately to make sure that someone who has committed wrongdoing will not be making vital decisions concerning the Welfare of the United States of America! Thank you for your attention to this matter. President DONALD J. TRUMP
items.summary_cn: Trump就美联储理事Cook的诉讼被最高法院退回一事表态，誓言阻止其继续任职，涉及美联储人事与独立性。

items.author: Trump
items.text: Treasury Secretary vows law-breaking leftist nonprofits to face prosecution, asset seizures: https://justthenews.com/accountability/political-ethics/treasury-secretary-vows-law-breaking-leftist-nonprofits-face
items.summary_cn: 财政部长誓言对违法左翼非营利组织进行起诉与资产冻结，涉及政治性监管与言论/资金自由话题。
